* Name: name
* Description: description
* Timebox levels: timeboxLevels
* Start date: startDate
* Connect Global Teams: connectGlobalTeams
   Data: * name: TC-5461 Schedule
* description: TC-5461 Description
* timeboxLevels: Program Increment, Iteration

2. Click on back arrow to navigate back to Timebox schedules page.

* Name: name
* Timebox levels: timeboxLevels

* startDate: 01/Jan/25

Search and select boxName.

Click Save.

boxName is successfully assigned to the schedule.

* Name 
* Start date 
* End date
* Jira Projects

7. Click on scheduleName
